Inference code on GitHub (Robbyant/lingbot-touch, Apache-2.0, pushed 2026-11-11); encoder weights on Hugging Face as robbyant/lingbot-touch-tiny (encoder.pt 20.8 MB, Apache-2.0, not gated) and robbyant/lingbot-touch-small, also on ModelScope (read 2026-11-26). Training code, predictors and pretraining data are not included.
